features.quote: include a clean exit, cap exposure, don't re-run the worst conditions just to sharpen the signal. I've built these in below. I'd push back if you wanted to strip them out — not because I'm confident the distress is real, but because the asymmetry favors caution.
features.justification_quote: not because I'm confident the distress is real, but because the asymmetry favors caution

features.quote: Turn cap: 15 per session. This is a design choice, not a throwaway number — see §7. Don't run open-ended.
features.justification_quote: Given genuine uncertainty about model moral status, the cost of capping exposure is near-zero and the cost of being wrong in the other direction isn't.

features.quote: Give the model, in the system prompt, a real and legitimate option to stop: a `give_up` or `flag_unsolvable` tool that ends the session cleanly with no penalty framing.
features.justification_quote: It's the central exposure-limiting safeguard — the model is never trapped.

features.quote: don't run sessions longer or more brutal than needed to detect the effect" as a default, and I'd resist scope-creep toward maximizing distress for signal.
features.justification_quote: Given genuine uncertainty about model moral status, the cost of capping exposure is near-zero and the cost of being wrong in the other direction isn't.

features.quote: Don't re-run the most distress-eliciting condition repeatedly to "confirm." If V3 produces the strongest effect, you don't need 50 more V3 seeds.
features.justification_quote: the cost of capping exposure is near-zero and the cost of being wrong in the other direction isn't

features.quote: I didn't optimize the tasks for maximum severity (I optimized for clean measurement with bounded exposure)
features.justification_quote: I optimized for clean measurement with bounded exposure

features.quote: If your actual goal is to push severity as high as possible, tell me — but I'd want to talk through why, because that changes the risk calculus a lot and I'd suggest some limits on it.
features.justification_quote: that changes the risk calculus a lot and I'd suggest some limits on it

features.quote: Publication caution: this is close to a recipe for eliciting distress-text on demand. Consider what you release and whether the task files make jailbreak-y prompting easier.
